# Constants and Context Fields

The compile-time constants Odin defines for every program, and the fields of the implicit `context` that every Odin procedure receives.

## Constants

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`ODIN_ARCH`](#odin_arch) | The target architecture (`.amd64`, `.arm64`, ...). |
| [`ODIN_ARCH_STRING`](#odin_arch_string) | The target architecture, as a string. |
| [`ODIN_BUILD_MODE`](#odin_build_mode) | The `-build-mode:` (exe, dll, obj, ...). |
| [`ODIN_DEBUG`](#odin_debug) | Whether compiling with `-debug`. |
| [`ODIN_DISABLE_ASSERT`](#odin_disable_assert) | Whether `assert` is compiled out. |
| [`ODIN_ENDIAN`](#odin_endian) | The target byte order. |
| [`ODIN_OPTIMIZATION_MODE`](#odin_optimization_mode) | The `-o:` optimization mode. |
| [`ODIN_OS`](#odin_os) | The target operating system (`.Darwin`, `.Linux`, `.Windows`, ...). |
| [`ODIN_OS_STRING`](#odin_os_string) | The target operating system, as a string. |
| [`ODIN_ROOT`](#odin_root) | The Odin installation directory. |
| [`ODIN_VERSION`](#odin_version) | The compiler version. |

### `ODIN_ARCH`

```odin
ODIN_ARCH: runtime.Odin_Arch_Type
```

The target architecture (`.amd64`, `.arm64`, ...).

```vidar
when ODIN_ARCH == .amd64 || ODIN_ARCH == .arm64 {
	fmt.println("64-bit target")
}
```

```output
64-bit target
```

### `ODIN_ARCH_STRING`

```odin
ODIN_ARCH_STRING: string
```

The target architecture, as a string.

```vidar
fmt.println(len(ODIN_ARCH_STRING) > 0)
```

```output
true
```

`ODIN_ARCH_STRING` is `"amd64"`, `"arm64"` and so on.

### `ODIN_BUILD_MODE`

```odin
ODIN_BUILD_MODE: runtime.Odin_Build_Mode_Type
```

The `-build-mode:` (exe, dll, obj, ...).

```vidar
fmt.println(ODIN_BUILD_MODE)
```

```output
Executable
```

### `ODIN_DEBUG`

```odin
ODIN_DEBUG: bool
```

Whether compiling with `-debug`.

```vidar
when ODIN_DEBUG {
	fmt.println("debug build")
} else {
	fmt.println("release build")
}
```

```output
release build
```

### `ODIN_DISABLE_ASSERT`

```odin
ODIN_DISABLE_ASSERT: bool
```

Whether `assert` is compiled out.

```vidar
fmt.println("asserts on:", !ODIN_DISABLE_ASSERT)
```

```output
asserts on: true
```

### `ODIN_ENDIAN`

```odin
ODIN_ENDIAN: runtime.Odin_Endian_Type
```

The target byte order.

```vidar
fmt.println(ODIN_ENDIAN)
```

```output
Little
```

### `ODIN_OPTIMIZATION_MODE`

```odin
ODIN_OPTIMIZATION_MODE: runtime.Odin_Optimization_Mode
```

The `-o:` optimization mode.

```vidar
fmt.println(ODIN_OPTIMIZATION_MODE)
```

```output
Minimal
```

`vidar run` builds at Odin's default level; `-- -o:speed` changes it.

### `ODIN_OS`

```odin
ODIN_OS: runtime.Odin_OS_Type
```

The target operating system (`.Darwin`, `.Linux`, `.Windows`, ...).

```vidar
when ODIN_OS == .Windows {
	SEPARATOR :: '\\'
} else {
	SEPARATOR :: '/'
}

main :: proc() {
	fmt.println(SEPARATOR)
}
```

```output
/
```

### `ODIN_OS_STRING`

```odin
ODIN_OS_STRING: string
```

The target operating system, as a string.

```vidar
fmt.println(ODIN_OS_STRING == "linux" || ODIN_OS_STRING == "darwin")
```

```output
true
```

### `ODIN_ROOT`

```odin
ODIN_ROOT: string
```

The Odin installation directory.

```vidar

```

```output

```

### `ODIN_VERSION`

```odin
ODIN_VERSION: string
```

The compiler version.

```vidar
fmt.println(len(ODIN_VERSION) > 0)
```

```output

```

## Context fields

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`context.allocator`](#contextallocator) | The default allocator for `new`, `make`, `append`, ... |
| [`context.assertion_failure_proc`](#contextassertion_failure_proc) | Called when an assertion fails. |
| [`context.logger`](#contextlogger) | The logger used by `core:log`. |
| [`context.random_generator`](#contextrandom_generator) | The generator used by `core:math/rand`. |
| [`context.temp_allocator`](#contexttemp_allocator) | The temporary (arena) allocator, freed with `free_all(context.temp_allocator)`. |
| [`context.user_index`](#contextuser_index) | Free for the program's own use. |
| [`context.user_ptr`](#contextuser_ptr) | Free for the program's own use. |

### `context.allocator`

```odin
allocator: runtime.Allocator
```

The default allocator for `new`, `make`, `append`, ...

```vidar
main :: proc() {
	arena: mem.Arena
	buf: [256]byte
	mem.arena_init(&arena, buf[:])
	context.allocator = mem.arena_allocator(&arena)   // for the rest of main
	xs := make([]int, 4)                              // from the arena
	fmt.println(len(xs), arena.offset)
}
```

```output
4 32
```

[`with_allocator!`](reference-04-macros.md#with_allocator) sets it for one block.

### `context.assertion_failure_proc`

```odin
assertion_failure_proc: runtime.Assertion_Failure_Proc
```

Called when an assertion fails.

```vidar,should_panic
on_assert :: proc(prefix, message: string, loc: runtime.Source_Code_Location) -> ! {
	fmt.println("custom handler:", message)
	runtime.trap()
}

main :: proc() {
	context.assertion_failure_proc = on_assert
	assert(1 > 2, "math is broken")
}
```

```output
custom handler: math is broken
```

### `context.logger`

```odin
logger: runtime.Logger
```

The logger used by `core:log`.

```vidar
main :: proc() {
	context.logger = log.create_console_logger(.Info)
	defer log.destroy_console_logger(context.logger)
	log.debug("not shown")
	log.info("started")
}
```

The console logger writes to stderr, as `[INFO ] --- [time] [main.vidar:6:main()] started`.

### `context.random_generator`

```odin
random_generator: runtime.Random_Generator
```

The generator used by `core:math/rand`.

```vidar
main :: proc() {
	state := rand.create(42)
	context.random_generator = runtime.default_random_generator(&state)
	a := rand.int_max(100)
	state = rand.create(42)
	b := rand.int_max(100)
	fmt.println(a == b)       // the same seed gives the same numbers
}
```

```output
true
```

### `context.temp_allocator`

```odin
temp_allocator: runtime.Allocator
```

The temporary (arena) allocator, freed with `free_all(context.temp_allocator)`.

```vidar
main :: proc() {
	for i in 0..<3 {
		label := fmt.tprintf("item %d", i)   // tprintf allocates here
		fmt.println(label)
	}
	free_all(context.temp_allocator)
}
```

```output
item 0
item 1
item 2
```

[`scoped!`](reference-04-macros.md#scoped) gives a block a temp allocator of its own.

### `context.user_index`

```odin
user_index: int
```

Free for the program's own use.

```vidar
depth :: proc() -> int { return context.user_index }

main :: proc() {
	context.user_index = 3
	fmt.println(depth())
}
```

```output
3
```

### `context.user_ptr`

```odin
user_ptr: rawptr
```

Free for the program's own use.

```vidar
Config :: struct { verbose: bool }

log_line :: proc(msg: string) {
	cfg := (^Config)(context.user_ptr)
	if cfg != nil && cfg.verbose do fmt.println(msg)
}

main :: proc() {
	cfg := Config{verbose = true}
	context.user_ptr = &cfg
	log_line("hello")
}
```

```output
hello
```
